summary:
The UI layer has six things that only work on Linux.
(1) main.c uses glib-unix SIGTERM/SIGINT sources and /proc/self/exe.
(2) data.c and admin_ui.c run python3 helpers through GSubprocess. On Windows I confirmed that GLib starts them through gspawn-win64-helper.exe, which calls _wspawnv. Python then opens a visible console window, and that window stays open for as long as the detached service runs. Python pipe output is also cp1254, so g_subprocess_communicate_utf8 fails on Turkish text.
(3) reset_ui.c restarts through /proc/self/cmdline plus `sh -c 'sleep 2; setsid run-radios.sh'`.
(4) preferences.c parses /proc/asound and shows a 'PulseAudio / PipeWire' label.
(5) content_scale.c corrects popup positions on X11 only. A probe confirmed that GDK Win32 emits moved-to-rect synchronously, so the same correction path can simply be enabled for GDK_IS_WIN32_DISPLAY.
(6) window.c registers Inter through Fontconfig. Windows Pango uses DirectWrite instead. A probe showed the WOFF2 file is rejected; the TTF is accepted but only under the family name 'Inter Variable Text', so the CSS needs that name added.

Bugs and compile failures:
- media.c:849-857 hangs the GUI thread in an endless loop. g_path_get_dirname("C:\\") returns "C:\\" (probe-verified), so climbing towards the root never stops.
- playlist.c will not compile: it uses openat, O_NOFOLLOW and st_mtim.
- The GVolumeMonitor USB list is always empty on Windows.
- realpath and g_shell_quote are used in UI code.
- File-name checks only reject '/'.
- IANA time zones return NULL from GLib on Windows (probe-verified), so station clocks and calendars silently fall back to UTC. This needs a shared time-zone shim owned by the core/time area.

Lifetime: the Linux design deliberately lets the SDBASE service outlive the GUI (start_new_session; the shutdown test asserts the service PID stays the same). The design therefore uses no kill-on-close job, and the Python launcher should spawn serve with CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB.

Recommended Windows design:
- Startup: GUI subsystem exe. Call AttachConsole(ATTACH_PARENT_PROCESS) only when the std handles are missing. In GUI mode call FreeConsole afterwards and write diagnostics to a log file. Parse arguments with g_win32_get_command_line + parse_strv. Get the exe path from GetModuleFileNameW. Run a first-run `prepare` helper, which takes over the launcher's init+start duties.
- Termination: a named event per PID (the SIGTERM equivalent), a console control handler, and a GDK filter for WM_QUERYENDSESSION/WM_ENDSESSION. WM_ENDSESSION runs an idempotent teardown synchronously, using ShutdownBlockReason so Windows waits.
- Helper processes: a CreateProcessW-based RadioSProcess with CREATE_NO_WINDOW, an absolute interpreter path chosen by a fixed resolution order, `-X utf8 -B`, cwd set to the project root, and a longer launch timeout on Windows.
- Relaunch: re-exec the same exe with the same arguments. The new instance waits on an inherited handle to the old process instead of sleeping 2 seconds.
- Content scale on Windows: GDK's integer scaling, plus handling for scale-factor changes and the tooltip cursor size.
- Drag and drop: GDK uses WM_DROPFILES and produces file:///C:/ URIs, which g_filename_from_uri already handles (probe table in the spec). The fixes needed are the import-root loop and skipping HIDDEN/SYSTEM entries.
- Device inventory and the maximum sample rate come from the WASAPI audio API.
- Default folders: g_get_user_special_dir works; there is a OneDrive risk.
key_decisions: The SDBASE service intentionally outlives the GUI (Linux: start_new_session; the test asserts the service PID is unchanged after GUI exit). Never put the launcher or the service in a GUI kill-on-close Job Object. The Python launcher spawns serve with CREATE_NO_WINDOW|CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP|CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB, falling back without BREAKAWAY if the job forbids it.

Replace GSubprocess/g_spawn for python helpers with a CreateProcessW-based RadioSProcess (CREATE_NO_WINDOW, STARTUPINFOEX handle list, GWin32InputStream pipes, g_child_watch on the process HANDLE). GLib's spawn helper uses _wspawnv (verified), which opens a visible console for python.exe. On POSIX the API wraps GSubprocess.

Interpreter resolution order: RADIOS_PYTHON env; then config python_command — absolute path used as-is (fail closed if missing; preserves the '/RadioS-no-lifecycle-helper' test); relative path with a separator resolved against the project root; bare python3/python/py mapped to the bundled <root>\runtime\python\python.exe, else SearchPathW skipping WindowsApps alias stubs. Always pass an absolute lpApplicationName. Always add '-X utf8 -B' plus PYTHONUTF8=1, PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. Child cwd is the project root.

Termination on Windows: a named event Local\RadioS.Desktop.Terminate.<pid> (SIGTERM role, used by tests and tools), SetConsoleCtrlHandler (Ctrl+C/Break = quit request; CLOSE = synchronous teardown with a 4.5 s wait), and gdk_window_add_filter(NULL) for WM_QUERYENDSESSION (ShutdownBlockReasonCreate, allow) and WM_ENDSESSION(TRUE), which runs the teardown synchronously. WM_CLOSE keeps going through GTK. shutdown_application becomes an idempotent application_teardown().

Console handling: AttachConsole(ATTACH_PARENT_PROCESS) only when the std handles are unusable, then freopen CONOUT$. In GUI mode call FreeConsole after startup unless RADIOS_KEEP_CONSOLE=1, so a later Ctrl+C or a closed terminal cannot kill the on-air app. When there is no stderr, redirect it to <log_root>/radios-desktop.log.

Parse the command line with g_win32_get_command_line()+g_option_context_parse_strv. Get the exe path from GetModuleFileNameW (strip \\?\). Root discovery stays a walk up from the exe directory; recommended layout is <root>\runtime\bin.

First-run preparation moves into the exe on Windows. In non-passive modes, if credentials.json is missing or setup-pending.json exists, run '<python> tools/radios_database.py prepare' (new subcommand implementing radios_launch.py init+start) synchronously with no console window. On failure show an error dialog and exit 1.

Relaunch after reset: re-exec the own exe with the original args, minus --smoke-test/--capture, and with an explicit --project-root appended. The new instance waits for the old one to exit through an inherited SYNCHRONIZE process handle passed in RADIOS_RELAUNCH_WAIT_HANDLE (validated with GetProcessId; 30 s timeout). This replaces 'sleep 2; setsid run-radios.sh'.

Fonts: on Windows use pango_font_map_add_font_file with assets/fonts/InterVariable.ttf (WOFF2 is rejected by DirectWrite — verified) and prepend 'Inter Variable Text' to the CSS families (radios.css:4, preferences.c:72). Skip FcInit on Windows.

content_scale.c: enable the X11 synchronous moved-to-rect re-anchoring for GDK_IS_WIN32_DISPLAY (verified synchronous on Win32). Divide the tooltip cursor size by the scale factor on Win32. Handle notify::scale-factor (WM_DPICHANGED) by recreating the offscreen surface. Accept integer GDK scaling (125/150/175% render at 1x); users rely on the existing workspace zoom.

Fix the media.c import-root loop with root-aware, case-insensitive radios_platform_path_has_prefix/path_is_root. When files share no common root, pass NULL so media_jobs falls back to the file's own directory. Skip HIDDEN/SYSTEM entries and junctions when walking folders.

Rekordbox USB: on Windows replace GVolumeMonitor with GetLogicalDriveStringsW + removable/USB bus detection. The uuid is the volume serial formatted %04X-%04X, which matches the Linux FAT uuid, so library keys stay compatible. Poll GetLogicalDrives while the dialog is open. Replace openat/O_NOFOLLOW/st_mtim with radios_platform_open_beneath + FileBasicInfo identity.
Use one portable file-name validator/sanitizer (Windows-reserved characters and device names, no trailing dot/space) in transfer_ui, workflow_hub and broadcast_ui (blocks ':' alternate data streams).
Ship no gdbus.exe, to avoid GApplication autolaunching a lingering session bus. Keep the gspawn helpers packaged for other GLib users.
risks: IANA time zones: g_time_zone_new_identifier('Europe/Istanbul') returns NULL on Windows (probe-verified). About 11 src/ui call sites silently fall back to UTC (station clock, calendar, schedules), and core/playout validation may reject zones. A cross-area shim is required before any UI acceptance.
media.c:849-857 is an endless loop on the GTK thread for files under a drive root or on different drives. It must be fixed before the first Windows drop test.

Without CREATE_NO_WINDOW and UTF-8 mode, the service shows a permanent console window (closing it kills the service) and service starts are reported as failures because the cp1254 output is not valid UTF-8.

The embedded CPython ._pth may enable isolated/safe-path mode: PYTHON* env vars ignored and the script directory not on sys.path, which breaks 'from radios_database_setup import' in tools. The tools/packaging owner must verify.
The 15 s launcher timeout can loop forever on slow Windows cold starts (Defender, store open). The spec raises it to ~75 s on Windows.
WM_ENDSESSION teardown must finish within the system's timeout (~5 s, extendable by ShutdownBlockReason). Long WAV finalization or preference saves could be cut short at logoff.

Per-monitor DPI with integer GDK scale: at 125-175% the UI is crisp but physically small. Moving the window between monitors of different scale exercises offscreen surface recreation, which X11 never tested.
WM_DROPFILES DnD: possible MAX_PATH truncation in GDK, .lnk resolution, no hover feedback, UIPI blocks drops if elevated. Synchronous g_file_test on unreachable UNC paths can freeze the UI.
The GtkFileChooser aborts the process if the GSettings schemas are not packaged. Missing Adwaita/SVG icon loaders produce warnings that abort tests under G_DEBUG=fatal-warnings.
GApplication may autolaunch gdbus.exe (lingering process, possible warnings) if gdbus.exe is shipped or found.
Windows releases LockFileEx locks of exited processes asynchronously. The shutdown test's 'GUI lock released' assertion must poll.
GUI tests need an unlocked interactive desktop session (no Xvfb equivalent). SendInput, SetCursorPos and pixel capture fail on locked or session-0 CI agents.

Mapped and subst drives canonicalize to UNC/real paths. C and Python must canonicalize the project root identically and compare case-insensitively, or _owned() will treat the GUI's own service as foreign.
Clipboard History and Cloud Clipboard can retain API tokens copied in admin_ui (optional hardening in the spec).
Default Music/Documents folders may be OneDrive-redirected (placeholders, sync locks causing sharing violations).
cross_area_dependencies: core/recovery: radios_recovery_gui_lock must keep returning a CRT int fd (_open_osfhandle of a CreateFileW handle with a shared LockFileEx at a high offset), so window.c close(fd) releases it. It also needs Windows owner/ACL checks replacing st_uid/st_mode.
core/config: replace realpath() in radios_project_root_find/resolve_inside_root with radios_platform_realpath; canonicalization must match Python os.path.realpath.
core/storage_locations: statvfs -> GetDiskFreeSpaceExW; junction-safe tree size; Windows absolute path syntax (drive/UNC) in storage.ini.

core/time (new): GTimeZone *radios_time_zone_new(const gchar *iana) mapping IANA -> POSIX TZ string (bundled tzdata TZif footer) or Windows zone name (CLDR windowsZones/ICU), used by all UI and core call sites.
core/external_access: libcurl CURLSSLOPT_NATIVE_CA for the HTTPS probe.

audio (WASAPI): guint radios_audio_backend_max_sample_rate(void) cached by the engine; const gchar *radios_audio_backend_display_name(void); snapshot devices with endpoint ID as name, FriendlyName as description, loopback inputs as monitor, '@default' = default eConsole endpoint; a test device replacing Pulse 'routing_microphone.monitor'.
MIDI (WinMM): radios_midi_ui_bind/technical device lists unchanged at the UI level.

tools (Python): new 'prepare' subcommand (radios_launch.py init+start semantics under operation_lock); python_command validator must accept Windows absolute paths with spaces and stop using shlex.split on Windows; spawn serve with sys.executable -X utf8 -B and CREATE_NO_WINDOW|CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP|CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB; console-ctrl graceful stop inside serve; restore_plan emits an absolute interpreter; service APIs accept Windows paths (destination_dir, package_path, media_root, source_path/source_root, storage dirs, managed_path returned canonical).

tools/tests (Python shims): request_graceful_stop(pid) via the named event Local\RadioS.Desktop.Terminate.<pid> (fallback WM_CLOSE); a LockFileEx-based lock_held() probe; Windows variants of the GUI runners without Xvfb/GDK_BACKEND.

packaging: <root>\runtime layout (bin, share, lib, etc, python); compiled GSettings schemas, Adwaita+hicolor icons, gdk-pixbuf SVG loader cache, GTK Turkish .mo, InterVariable.ttf; keep the gspawn-win64-helper*.exe files; do not ship gdbus.exe; exe .rc with icon/VERSIONINFO/manifest (PerMonitorV2, UTF-8 ACP, longPathAware, asInvoker); Start-menu shortcut AppUserModelID 'RadioS.Desktop'; user-writable install location; Windows radios.example.ini with python_command = runtime/python/python.exe.

build/CMake: -mwindows for radios.exe, gio-windows-2.0, -lshell32 -lole32 -luser32 -ladvapi32; RADIOS_GUI_TEST_ENV (no GDK_BACKEND=x11 on Windows); native_window WORKING_DIRECTORY set to the build dir; xtst/x11 pkg-config only on Linux.
platform_api_needs: gchar *radios_platform_executable_path(GError **error) — absolute UTF-8 path of the running exe (Windows: GetModuleFileNameW in a buffer-growing loop up to 32768, strip \\?\ and map \\?\UNC\ to \\; POSIX: /proc/self/exe, else g_find_program_in_path(argv0)).
gchar **radios_platform_get_argv(gint argc, gchar **argv) — UTF-8 argv including argv[0] (Windows: g_win32_get_command_line(); POSIX: g_strdupv(argv)); free with g_strfreev.

gboolean radios_platform_attach_parent_console(void) — Windows: when GetStdHandle(STD_OUTPUT/ERROR) is NULL/INVALID/FILE_TYPE_UNKNOWN, call AttachConsole(ATTACH_PARENT_PROCESS) and freopen the missing streams to CONOUT$; returns TRUE if attached. POSIX: FALSE.
void radios_platform_detach_console(void) — FreeConsole() if previously attached; POSIX no-op.

gboolean radios_platform_redirect_stderr_to_log(const gchar *log_path, gsize rotate_bytes, GError **error) — when stderr is unusable, rotate (rename to .1 before opening) and reopen stderr in append mode with share-deny-none.
void radios_platform_relaunch_wait(void) — Windows: consume and unset RADIOS_RELAUNCH_WAIT_HANDLE, accept only if GetProcessId(h)!=0, WaitForSingleObject(h, 30000), CloseHandle. POSIX no-op.

RadioSProcess *radios_process_spawn(const gchar *const *argv, const gchar *working_directory, const gchar *const *env_overrides, RadioSProcessFlags flags, GError **error) — flags: RADIOS_PROCESS_CAPTURE_STDOUT, _CAPTURE_STDERR, _NO_WINDOW (CREATE_NO_WINDOW), _DETACHED (CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP + CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB with fallback, stdio to NUL / setsid on POSIX), _PASS_SELF_HANDLE (inherit a SYNCHRONIZE handle to self, exported as RADIOS_RELAUNCH_WAIT_HANDLE). Windows: CreateProcessW with an absolute lpApplicationName, CommandLineToArgvW-compatible quoting, STARTUPINFOEX handle list, CREATE_UNICODE_ENVIRONMENT, stdin NUL. POSIX: wraps GSubprocess. env_overrides entries are 'NAME=VALUE', or 'NAME=' to unset.

void radios_process_communicate_utf8_async(RadioSProcess *p, gsize max_bytes_per_stream, GCancellable *cancellable, GAsyncReadyCallback callback, gpointer user_data); gboolean radios_process_communicate_utf8_finish(RadioSProcess *p, GAsyncResult *result, gchar **stdout_text, gchar **stderr_text, GError **error) — completes after both streams reach EOF and the child exited; invalid UTF-8 or a size overflow is an error.

gboolean radios_process_get_successful(RadioSProcess *p); gint radios_process_get_exit_status(RadioSProcess *p); void radios_process_force_exit(RadioSProcess *p) (TerminateProcess(h,1)/SIGKILL, idempotent); RadioSProcess *radios_process_ref(RadioSProcess *p); void radios_process_unref(RadioSProcess *p).

gboolean radios_process_spawn_detached(const gchar *const *argv, const gchar *working_directory, const gchar *const *env_overrides, RadioSProcessFlags flags, GError **error) — fire-and-forget (relaunch).

gchar *radios_python_executable(const RadioSConfig *config, GError **error) — resolution order: RADIOS_PYTHON env (absolute, must exist); config python_command absolute path (must exist, no fallback); relative path containing '/' or '\\' resolved against project_root; bare python3/python/py mapped to <root>\runtime\python\python.exe, then SearchPathW('python.exe') skipping %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\WindowsApps and IO_REPARSE_TAG_APPEXECLINK stubs; returns an absolute UTF-8 path.

gchar *radios_platform_quote_command_for_display(const gchar *const *argv) — POSIX: space-joined g_shell_quote; Windows: CommandLineToArgvW-compatible quoting with a '& ' prefix when argv[0] is quoted (PowerShell).

gchar *radios_platform_realpath(const gchar *path, GError **error) — POSIX realpath; Windows CreateFileW(FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES, share all, FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS) + GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(FILE_NAME_NORMALIZED|VOLUME_NAME_DOS), strip \\?\ and map \\?\UNC\ to \\.

gboolean radios_platform_path_has_prefix(const gchar *path, const gchar *root) — TRUE when root equals path or is an ancestor at a component boundary; a root ending in a separator (C:\, \\srv\share\, /) matches every descendant; '/' and '\\' equivalent and case-insensitive (CompareStringOrdinal ignore-case) on Windows.
gboolean radios_platform_path_is_root(const gchar *path) — g_path_skip_root(path) != NULL && *skip == '\0'.

gboolean radios_platform_file_name_check(const gchar *name, gsize max_bytes, GError **error) and gchar *radios_platform_sanitize_file_name(const gchar *name) — reject/replace control chars, < > : \" / \\ | ? *, a leading '.', trailing dot or space, and reserved device names CON PRN AUX NUL COM1-9 LPT1-9 (case-insensitive, with any extension); identical rules on all platforms.

gboolean radios_platform_path_is_hidden(const gchar *path, const gchar *basename) — TRUE for names starting with '.', and on Windows also FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN|FILE_ATTRIBUTE_SYSTEM; gboolean radios_platform_path_is_link(const gchar *path) — symlink, or on Windows any FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT that is a symlink or junction.

gint radios_platform_open_beneath(const gchar *root, const gchar *const *components, GError **error) and gint radios_platform_open_regular_nofollow(const gchar *path, GError **error) — read-only CRT fd; every intermediate component must be a real directory (no reparse point), held open without FILE_SHARE_DELETE until the leaf is opened; the leaf must be a regular non-reparse file. POSIX uses openat with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC and O_NONBLOCK.

gboolean radios_platform_fd_identity(gint fd, RadioSFileIdentity *out, GError **error) with typedef struct { guint64 size; gint64 mtime_ns, ctime_ns; guint64 volume, file_id; } RadioSFileIdentity — Windows: FileBasicInfo LastWriteTime/ChangeTime, FileStandardInfo EndOfFile, FileIdInfo; POSIX: fstat st_mtim/st_ctim/st_dev/st_ino.

GPtrArray *radios_platform_removable_volumes(void) returning RadioSVolume { gchar *root; gchar *label; gchar *uuid; }, plus void radios_volume_free(RadioSVolume *v) — Windows: GetLogicalDriveStringsW, keep DRIVE_REMOVABLE or DRIVE_FIXED with IOCTL_STORAGE_QUERY_PROPERTY bus type USB/SD/MMC, GetVolumeInformationW under SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS, uuid = '%04X-%04X' of the serial; guint32 radios_platform_logical_drives_mask(void) for polling.

RadioSTermination *radios_termination_install(RadioSTerminateFunc func, gpointer data); void radios_termination_teardown_done(RadioSTermination *t); void radios_termination_remove(RadioSTermination *t); gchar *radios_termination_event_name(guint32 pid) — POSIX: g_unix_signal_add SIGTERM/SIGINT -> RADIOS_TERMINATE_REQUEST. Windows: named manual-reset event Local\RadioS.Desktop.Terminate.<pid> with RegisterWaitForSingleObject, and SetConsoleCtrlHandler (C/BREAK -> REQUEST; CLOSE/LOGOFF/SHUTDOWN -> NOW, then wait up to 4.5 s for teardown_done). The callback always runs on the GTK thread via g_idle_add_full(G_PRIORITY_HIGH). The UI layer adds a gdk_window_add_filter(NULL) handler for WM_QUERYENDSESSION/WM_ENDSESSION that calls func(RADIOS_TERMINATE_NOW) synchronously.

gboolean radios_platform_register_app_font(const gchar *assets_root, GError **error) — POSIX: FcInit + FcConfigAppFontAddFile(fonts/InterVariable.woff2); Windows: pango_font_map_add_font_file(pango_cairo_font_map_get_default(), fonts/InterVariable.ttf) (DirectWrite family 'Inter Variable Text').

gboolean radios_platform_open_uri(GtkWindow *parent, const gchar *uri, GError **error) — try gtk_show_uri_on_window first (keeps the test --wrap seam), on Windows fall back to ShellExecuteExW(SEE_MASK_NOASYNC, L"open").
void radios_platform_set_app_user_model_id(const gchar *id) — Windows SetCurrentProcessExplicitAppUserModelID; POSIX no-op.

Python shim (tools/_platform.py, consumed by tests): request_graceful_stop(pid, timeout) — OpenEventW(EVENT_MODIFY_STATE, 'Local\\RadioS.Desktop.Terminate.<pid>') + SetEvent, falling back to WM_CLOSE to the PID's top-level windows; lock_held(path) via LockFileEx(FAIL_IMMEDIATELY) on the same high offset the C side uses.
